# EuroCheapo

> > Expert reviews and budget travel guides for affordable hotels and destinations across Europe, including London, Paris, Venice, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Rome, Berlin, and Prague.

EuroCheapo, founded by Thomas Meyers, provides comprehensive budget travel resources for European destinations, featuring hotel reviews, destination guides, and money-saving tips for travelers seeking affordable accommodation and authentic experiences across the continent.

## Key Topics

- Budget European travel
- Cheap hotel reviews
- London budget accommodation
- Paris affordable hotels
- Venice on a budget
- Amsterdam budget stays
- Barcelona cheap hotels
- Rome budget travel
- Berlin affordable accommodation
- Prague budget guide
- European destinations
- Travel tips and guides
- Budget beaches Europe
- Thomas Meyers travel expertise

## Essential Pages

- [Expert Reviews of Cheap Hotels in Europe - EuroCheapo](https://www.eurocheapo.com/): Homepage featuring budget hotel reviews in London, Paris, Venice, Amsterdam
- [Cheap Hotels In Europe: EuroCheapo's Guide to Cheap Europe Hotels](https://www.eurocheapo.com/allcities.html): Directory of cheap hotels across European cities including Vienna, Bruges
- [About Us : EuroCheapo.com](https://www.eurocheapo.com/us/): About EuroCheapo team and mission for budget European travel guides
- [About US | EuroCheapo.com](https://www.eurocheapo.com/blog/about-us): Mission statement by Thomas Meyers on affordable European travel
